title: Looks Classy; Nice Quality
text: Looks Classy; Nice Quality. Very nice looking tablecloth and seems to be very good quality.  Wasn't sure I would like the charcoal color, but it's very classy looking.  Has a nice feel to the material.  Great that it is supposed to be water resistant, but I haven't tried dumping water on it to find out, nor have I yet spilled anything on it.  If it help with spills at all, that's a plus, as most tablecloths just soak up the water.  I don't think you would go wrong with this.  If you have kids that tend to spill liquids a lot and you don't want to put a cheap looking tablecloth on your table, this might be just the thing for you.

details.Product Care Instructions: Machine Wash, Cold, Gentle Cycle. Wash dark colors separately. Use non-Chlorine Bleach only. Tumble dry low. Remove promptly. Light iron if necessary.
